system.description:
Draw power from pain, momentarily fueling greater feats when struck.

  • Level 1: 1 temporary CP per 10 damage
  • Level 2: 2 temporary CP per 10 damage
  • Level 3: 3 temporary CP per 10 damage
  • Level 4: 4 temporary CP per 10 damage
  • Level 5: 5 temporary CP per 10 damage
  • Level 6: 6 temporary CP per 10 damage
